newsitem.title: POLAND: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 16.23 pct.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Polish banks see end-97 CPI at 16.23 pct.

text.p: Inflation expectations among Polish banks eased in January, a monthly Reuter poll of the 25 biggest banks showed on Friday.

Banks predicted average year-on-year inflation for the end of 1997 to be 16.23 percent, down from 16.35 percent last month but well above the government's prediction of 13 percent. Forecasts ranged between 14.70 and 17.50 percent.
Banks predicted monthly inflation this month against December would be 2.3 percent on average with a range of forecasts from 1.1 percent to 3.8 percent. @
Banks predicted year-on-year inflation in January 1998 at an average 15.85 percent, with the range from 12.0 to 17.25 percent.
